# Vetta 0.6.32
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-27 -->

## English

### New

- Conversations in a workspace can now see the other projects in the same workspace and read their files without asking each time; edits still need your approval. Turn it off per workspace in the New / Edit workspace dialog (on by default).
- Plugins can now read the current conversation's generation speed, time to first token, and token usage to show live speed readouts. The new permission behind it exposes only these numbers, not the conversation itself.

### Improvements

- Workspaces and their project grouping are now saved in Vetta's data folder alongside your projects and conversations. Existing workspaces move over automatically when you upgrade; nothing to do.

## 中文

### 新增

- 工作空间里的对话现在能看见同空间的其他项目，读取其中的文件不必逐次授权，修改仍需你确认。可在新建/编辑工作空间弹窗里按空间关闭，默认开启。
- 插件可以读取当前对话的生成速度、首字延迟和 token 用量，用来显示实时速度；对应的新权限只能看到这些数字，看不到对话内容。

### 改进

- 工作空间及项目分组改为和项目、对话一起保存在 Vetta 数据目录里。升级时自动迁移，无需任何操作。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.31...v0.6.32
